# mauricioperera.github.io

> Mauricio Perera's GitHub Pages site. Publishes an executable static skill
> (site_facts) per the llms-txt-skills standard, plus skills aggregated from
> project sites on this origin — KDD under the `kdd` scope (Executable
> Skills v0.5 §2.5).
